requires.label: Income not more than 250% FPL
requires.quote: (III)The patient’s annual family income is NOT more than two hundred fifty percent (250%) of the federal poverty guidelines.

rules.label: Self-pay discount for non-qualifying uninsured patients
rules.quote: a.All uninsured patients receive a 40% Self-Pay discount on their account balance at the time of billing.

application.quote: (IV)The patient complies in supplying the necessary information to AVRMC within 182 days of requested date.

notes: Policy references Colorado Indigent Care Program (CICP) and Colorado Hospital Discounted Care Act (HDC) but does not specify exact discount percentages for those programs in the text provided.
Screening must occur within 45 days of date of service or discharge per Section 3, but this is a hospital procedural timing, not a patient application deadline.
Patients denied financial assistance receive a letter with reason for denial.
If third-party coverage is discovered later, financial assistance write-off is reversed and third-party insurance is billed.
Opt-out forms must be signed; verbal decline is not valid for opting out.
Hospital will contact patient monthly for six months after discharge if they do not opt out or decline screening verbally.
If patient requests cessation of contact, hospital must document and record the request.
If no response after 182 days of contact attempts, lack of cooperation is considered an informed decision to decline screening.
Policy effective for dates of service on or subsequent to September 1, 2022.
Policy applies to all entities of the hospital with the same federal identification number.
0 may leave out a condition: Deadline is 182 days from requested date, which may differ from date of service.
